title: A wider standing-wave box
hook: Change box width and predict allowed wavelength.
misconception: allowed wavelength stays fixed when box width doubles.
objective: Apply λ_n = 2L/n to compare allowed wavelength when box width changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a one-dimensional infinite square well with fixed positive integer quantum number, λ_n = 2L/n. When box width doubles, allowed wavelength becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model λ_n = 2L/n; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a one-dimensional infinite square well with fixed positive integer quantum number, with a nonzero initial result. If box width triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on allowed wavelength?
recall.why: Apply λ_n = 2L/n under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
